phase_correlation_shift — FIT registration op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.phase_correlation_shift(image1, image2, window: 'str | None' = 'hann', whitening: 'float' = 0.5) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import filters_freq; filters_freq.phase_correlation_shift(image1, image2, window: 'str | None' = 'hann', whitening: 'float' = 0.5) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsfit.get("phase_correlation_shift"))

Usage

Estimate the subpixel translation needed to align two images by phase-only correlation.

This reuses phase_correlation_fft and refines each peak coordinate with the three-point parabolic estimator on the periodic correlation surface. The sign convention is identical to that function: when image2 = shift(image1, (dy, dx)), the result is approximately (-dy, -dx) -- the displacement required to align image1 with image2. Returns row_shift/col_shift (also dy/dx), peak and peak_ratio (largest peak divided by the best peak outside its 3x3 neighbourhood). Constant or textureless inputs raise ValueError.
